publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.4.0 adds TCP, DNS, TLS certificate and domain expiry checks in the hosted Worker or a private runner, and UDP, ICMP ping, SMTP/POP3/IMAP and multi-step API checks on a private runner. HTTP checks gain complete assertions, runner-held request credentials and explicit TLS trust exceptions; slow responses alert separately from outages. Heartbeat jobs report start, success and failure with masked output, cron schedules and ready-to-run scheduler examples. Confirmed incidents route by monitor, service and group with per-contact delays and reminders; custom webhook templates, owner incident notes and root causes, redacted failure snapshots, period reports with PDF and CSV, a versioned read API, Prometheus metrics, catalog bulk actions, recurring maintenance and scoped private-network runners are included. The release pins rer 0.2.65. This is a minor release. Back up first: export the console archive and the D1 database. Upgrading from 0.3.0 applies additive migrations 0038 to 0049 and keeps monitors, history, incidents, destinations and private settings; a hosted install deployed with 0.3.0 must first copy SESSION_SECRET and UPTIME_RUNNER_KEY into .rer/deploy/<environment>.secrets.env (see CHANGELOG.md). SMS, voice, chat apps other than Slack, on-call paging, SSO and multi-factor sign-in are not included.
